南洋廳統計年鑑 1938

Nan'yōchō tōkei nenkan (Statistical Yearbook of the South Seas Government), 第八回 (No. 8), figures mainly for 昭和9–13 (1934–1938), published 昭和15年3月 (March 1940)
南洋廳長官官房調査課, パラオ (昭和十五年)

All 183 numbered tables are transcribed, with the appendix table of weights and measures (度量衡比較表); the contents, the statistical charts (統計圖表), the maps and the colophon are not. The contents list the tables without chapter headings; chapters are assigned from the 總目次 start pages, with the liquor-trade tables (160–162) kept under 貿易 and the local-finance tables (179–180) under 財政 where they share a chapter's first page. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one, and long tables read in sections by different readers are joined. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Figures are kept exactly as printed, including points, spaces or semicolons printed where a comma or decimal point is expected. Small figures printed above a cell (foreigners, quantities) are given in the same cell after the figure; in the trade and fisheries tables many of these small quantities and unit marks are too blurred to read and are marked [?]. No errata slip was found in this copy. About 470 of some 73,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?]; a literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?.
